notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment fused בְּכִי גָדוֹל into a single 'sore' unit. Rule 30 fuses only where the one English word carries the sense of every morpheme placed in it, and 'sore' writes גָדוֹל's magnitude while the weeping is already written by 'wept' on the finite verb. בְּכִי is therefore the unrendered occurrence of a repeated element under rule 22's first sentence, and גָדוֹל takes 'sore' on its own. The unit count moves from 26 to 27.

Two particles of entreaty stand in the clause and the ASV writes two entreaty renderings ('now' and 'I beseech thee'); each particle takes one, and the competing pairing is named in the אָנָּה unit's note.
בְּעֵינֶיךָ is split three ways because the ASV writes a word for each morpheme, so rule 6's fused reading of בְּעֵינֵי does not reach it.
